empty.title: No template
empty.description: Create a first template to get started.

editor.specsError: Unable to load the node catalog:
editor.layoutSaveError: Layout not saved — will retry on the next move.

wiring.title: Wiring
wiring.description: Wire the inputs and outputs to workflow variables.

config.noParams: No specific parameter to configure for this step kind.

polymorphism.description: Determines the port signature of this step.

ticketRef.label: Ticket reference (fallback)
ticketRef.placeholder: e.g. ENG-123 (otherwise read from the input)

actorRole.label: Role for validation
actorRole.description: Active only when human validation is required (see Behavior).

cwd.label: Working directory (CLI cwd)
cwd.description: All subsequent claude_code.invoke steps will use this cwd until the next workspace.set.

baseDir.label: Clone root (baseDir)
baseDir.description: Authorized root for the clone — the wipe and clone can never escape it. Leave empty to use the managed default (userData/clones).

cleanBefore.label: Wipe before cloning
cleanBefore.description: When on (default), the target folder is removed then re-cloned — replaying the step is idempotent. When off, the step fails if the target already exists and is not empty.

project.label: Project
project.description: Numeric id or group/project path. Can also come from the wired input.

baseUrl.label: GitLab base URL (optional)
baseUrl.description: Leave empty for https://gitlab.com; set it for a self-hosted instance.

project.label: Project
project.description: Numeric id or group/project path. Inferred from the wired MR input if left empty.

iid.label: MR iid
iid.description: Internal id of the merge request. Inferred from the wired MR input if left empty.

baseUrl.label: GitLab base URL (optional)
baseUrl.description: Leave empty for https://gitlab.com; set it for a self-hosted instance.

maxOutput.label: Max captured size (KiB)
maxOutput.description: Automatically branches on the exit code: outputs success (exit 0) / failure (exit ≠ 0, timeout included), plus stdout / stderr verbatim. Requires an upstream workspace.set step. No env variable from the Electron process is exposed by default.

customExitCodes.label: Custom exit-code branches
customExitCodes.description: When enabled, replaces success/failure with named ports mapped to exit codes (with a required catch-all). The stdout/stderr ports remain unchanged.

path.label: Markdown file path
path.description: Absolute path picked via the file picker. The file content is exposed as a Markdown artifact output.

skill.label: Skill
skill.description: Saved skill whose body will be exposed as a Markdown artifact output.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: In template mode, the main port is a template whose {{example}} placeholders are replaced by the other ports — addressed by variable via readsFrom, otherwise by port name.

onMissing.label: Unresolved placeholder
onMissing.description: Behavior if a {{example}} in the template has no value provided.

onUnused.label: Wired port not referenced
onUnused.description: Behavior if a wired port doesn't appear in any placeholder of the template.

perEntry.title: Prefix / suffix per entry
perEntry.description: Optional. Wraps each entry before concatenation. Empty ⇒ ignored.

wiring.empty: This step has neither input nor output.

note.label: Note
note.description: Free-form note attached to this step of the template.
note.placeholder: Add a note about this step…

id.label: Identifier
id.description: Used in transitions and by the execution engine.

suggestions.description: A plugin offers nodes suited to this kind. Insert it manually into the graph if useful.

parser.label: Parser to apply
parser.description: The saved parser transforms the input artifact. Its output must conform to the kind selected in `outputKind`.

urlFallback.label: Fallback URL
urlFallback.description: Used if the url input is not wired. The input takes priority.

headers.label: Static headers
headers.description: Do not put a real secret here: they are stored in plaintext in the template.

body.label: Request body (fallback)
body.description: Used if the body input is not wired. Sent as-is (JSON recommended).

verdictKind.label: Verdict kind
verdictKind.description: Kind of the input artifact the runner will inspect (Markdown.body trimmed).

cases.label: Branches (cases)
cases.description: Each case becomes an output port; only one will be produced at runtime.

projections.label: JSONPath projections
projections.description: Each slot becomes a Json output port. The result is always an array of matches.

sumType.label: Sum type (OneOf<…>)
sumType.description: Each variant becomes a typed output port {{variantPort}}. The runner dispatches on the payload's variantKind discriminator. At least 2 variants, {{max}} max.

resetAll.title: Reset all settings
resetAll.description: Permanently delete all user settings: API keys, LLM models, active channel, base prompt, theme, language and density. The app then restarts on its default values.
resetAll.confirm:
Reset all user settings?

This action is irreversible: API keys, models, active channel, base prompt and display preferences will be deleted. The app will reload.

wipeAll.title: Erase everything (settings + data)
wipeAll.description: Permanently delete all user settings AND wipe the database: workflows, instances, artifacts, chat history, channels and plugin data. Everything is erased and the app restarts on a clean install.
wipeAll.confirm:
Erase ALL settings and data?

This action is irreversible: every setting, all workflows, instances, artifacts, chat history and channels will be permanently deleted. The app will restart on a clean state.

panelShadows.title: Panel shadows
panelShadows.description: Show the elevation shadow cast by the left and right side panels onto the editor.

linear.title: Linear — API key
linear.description: Used by the linear.fetch steps. Stored encrypted locally (OS keychain), never returned in plaintext to the UI.
linear.configured: A key is currently configured (ends with <mono>…{{lastFour}}</mono>). Enter a new key to replace it, or delete it.
linear.notConfigured: No key configured. Generate a Personal API Key from Linear (Settings → API).

gitlab.title: GitLab — access token
gitlab.description: Used by the git.clone steps to clone private repositories. Stored encrypted locally (OS keychain), never returned in plaintext to the UI.
gitlab.configured: A token is currently configured (ends with <mono>…{{lastFour}}</mono>). Enter a new token to replace it, or delete it.
gitlab.notConfigured: No token configured. Generate a Personal Access Token from GitLab (Preferences → Access Tokens) with the read_repository scope.

openRouter.description: Used by openrouter.invoke steps and by the chat (openrouter/* models). The key is encrypted locally (OS keychain), never returned in plaintext to the UI.

llm.keyConfigured: A key is currently configured (ends with <mono>…{{lastFour}}</mono>). Enter a new key to replace it, or delete it.
llm.keyNotConfigured: No key configured. Generate a key on <mono>openrouter.ai</mono> and paste it here.
llm.modelExists: This model is already in the list.
llm.keepOneModel: Keep at least one model in the list.

models.title: Available models
models.description: OpenRouter identifiers (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4). The model marked as default is used for new conversations and by openrouter.invoke steps without a model in their config. The chat selector lets you choose among these models.

test.title: Test the connection
test.description: Sends a short message to OpenRouter with the configured key and model. No significant quota consumed.

mcp.description: The app exposes a local MCP server over HTTP. Run the matching command in your terminal to declare it in Claude Code or Codex CLI. The app must be open for the server to respond.

playground.noParams: No parameter — click Run to launch the call.

plugins.title: Loaded plugins
plugins.description: Built-in (shipped with the app) or user (dropped in the plugins folder). A user plugin requires an explicit authorization before its first load. Revocation is hot — the app does not need to be restarted.
plugins.coreTooltip: Core plugin — required by templates and stored artifacts

authorize.title: Authorize {{name}}?
authorize.description: This plugin requests the following permissions. Third-party code runs with the privileges of the main process — only authorize plugins you trust.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Partition your templates, skills, artifact types, parsers and runs by context. Select a channel from the sidebar to rebind all the lists. The <mono>personal</mono> channel is the default and cannot be deleted.
channels.cannotDeleteDefault: The default channel cannot be deleted.
channels.deleteConfirm:
Delete the channel "{{id}}"?

Attached entities will become global (channel_id = NULL).

parsers.title: Parsers
parsers.description: Library of reusable transformations. Plug them into a graph via a `transform.run` node.
parsers.empty: No parser. Create one to reduce the payload, or leave empty to pass the raw data to the LLM.

editor.newDescription: Define a simplified schema, then configure a parser to reduce the raw payload.

readonly.title: Read-only
readonly.body: This type is read-only (source: {{source}}). To adapt it, copy it as a user type.

collision.title: Duplicate schema
collision.body: Same structural hash as “{{name}}” ({{ref}}). Ports will treat it as equivalent — you can reference the existing type instead of saving a duplicate.

fields.rawHint: JSON Schema describing the input payload. Leave empty if untyped.
fields.sampleRawHint: Example raw payload, used by the playground.
fields.markdownTemplateHint: Human-friendly Markdown template using {{field}} placeholders for top-level fields. Used by `render.markdown` and the artifact preview. Leave empty to fall back to pretty-printed JSON.

errors.idSlug: The identifier must be a lowercase slug (a–z, 0–9, '.', '-').
errors.versionFormat: The version must have the form 'v<n>' (e.g. 'v1').

review.stepGone: This step no longer exists in the run.
review.notAwaiting: This step is no longer awaiting validation.
review.noLoopTarget: To send feedback and re-run this step, add a “Feedback loop” transition on this node (self-loop) in the template.
review.noArtifact: (no artifact to review — just enter a summary)
